Jim Gates is a theoretical physicist known for work on supersymmetry, and he sits with Danny Jones to range far beyond the lecture hall. The advertised topics run from DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, to warp drives, supergravity, and the old question of life elsewhere, even on Jupiter.

Gates separates what physics allows from what it forbids, which makes him a useful guide through speculative ground. Jones asks the questions a curious layman would ask, and Gates answers with the patience of a teacher who enjoys them. Listeners get real science at the core and informed guessing at the edges, with the boundary between the two marked more honestly than most shows in this space bother to mark it.
